verdict.rationale: Authy is a 2FA authenticator app and verification API, not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from plugged-in MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Authy ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
